verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a Vulkan backend or AMD acceleration that avoids a ROCm install. The only related item says LocalAI auto-detects AMD GPUs and downloads an 'appropriate backend', which does not establish Vulkan support or freedom from ROCm. That is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install
